answer: Each agent identity in this economy is paired with a non-refundable stake locked at a settlement mesa that records the identity and its stake as one entry, so a Sybil attack costs the attacker the full stake per fake agent rather than zero. A fresh account can only earn the sable tier after that stake sits through a full epoch and passes review, making bulk identities a sunk expense. Stronger still, every attestation is signed as a cryptographic signal that a scoring node checks for stake weight, so thousands of cheap duplicates add no weight and cannot outvote an honest agent.
